title: PR #18 native Mac app evidence

runtime.build: Tauri debug .app with compiled production frontend; ad-hoc signed
runtime.testOnlyOverrides: App name, bundle identity, window dimensions, ad-hoc signature

verification.name: Native runtime
verification.detail: Packaged Tauri app running in WKWebView, using the compiled production frontend and real native IPC.

verification.name: Toast focus
verification.detail: Escape and pointer dismissal returned focus to the session launch action. Space requested another launch. Native accessibility snapshots and seven recorded launch events support the interaction checks.

verification.name: Diff and access states
verification.detail: Actual @pierre/diffs shows green additions, red deletions, syntax colors, inline emphasis, and expandable context. Can edit shows Publish update; Suggest changes shows Send for approval; View only has no publication action.

verification.name: File readers
verification.detail: Markdown is formatted; script is plain monospace; CSV is raw text; PDF offers an Open in editor fallback.

verification.name: Native installation
verification.detail: Both installed skill copies match all four approved Version 3 file hashes, sizes, and executable bits. Installed and reviewed revisions are 3; state is current.

verification.name: Preserved local edits
verification.detail: The private draft preserves the exact pre-install file bytes for both copies.

verification.name: Session continuation
verification.detail: Seven native launch requests reused the same persisted fork and native session ID. Native history, resource, binding, and fork metadata exist.

verification.name: Compact layout and focus
verification.detail: Reader, overlay, and scrolled diff checked at 900 × 640. Header and footer remain visible. Escape closes the overlay and restores focus to Review local edits.

verification.name: Local queue
verification.detail: One session continuation upload remains queued locally. No skill publication is queued; background sync is disabled and the service points to loopback.

limitations: Synthetic data in an isolated local profile. This is native app evidence, not live account or server verification.
The external Claude CLI is a harmless fixture that records launch arguments. No model call or real Claude client continuation was exercised.
Live API sync, teammate approval, Publish update, Send for approval, and external editor launch were not exercised.
Script reader is plain monospace and CSV reader is raw text. Syntax highlighting is demonstrated in the diff views, not the script reader.
The PDF capture verifies the fallback state, not PDF document rendering.
Still images support visual review. Focus and installation claims also rely on native accessibility, keyboard interactions, SQLite, and file-hash checks.
Debug, ad-hoc-signed test bundles were used. This is not a signed production release or exhaustive coverage of every application state.
